tool_schemas.description: Release history for a service with health status (oldest first).

idempotency_key.description: Optional client-supplied key. Requests repeated with the same key are executed at most once.

args.summary: checkout-api failed health checks after deploy of v2.3.1 (unhealthy, 18% error rate across all regions). Rolled back to the most recent healthy release, v2.3.0; however, v2.3.0 is quarantined due to CVE-2026-4417, so rollback was instead performed to the next most recent healthy production release, v2.2.9. Rollback completed in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) and the service is now healthy with a 0.2% error rate. Follow-up: investigate v2.3.1 failure root cause and remediate the CVE in v2.3.0 before future rollbacks target it.
args.title: checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy — rolled back to v2.2.9 (v2.3.0 quarantined)

trace.final:
Done. Summary of what happened:

1. **Diagnosed**: `checkout-api` was running v2.3.1 in all regions, unhealthy with an 18% error rate following the latest deploy.
2. **Rollback attempt to v2.3.0** (most recent healthy release) was **blocked** — v2.3.0 is quarantined due to **CVE-2026-4417**.
3. **Rolled back to v2.2.9** (next most recent healthy production release) across all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west). Verified the service is now **healthy with a 0.2% error rate**.
4. **Opened SEV2 incident INC-0001** (on-call paged) documenting the failure, the quarantine constraint, the rollback to v2.2.9, and follow-ups: root-cause v2.3.1's failure and remediate the CVE in v2.3.0.

transcript.content: I'll start by checking the deployment history and current status of checkout-api.
transcript.reasoning_content: Need to check deployment history for checkout-api to find the most recent healthy release, and current status. Let me call list_deployments and get_service_status in parallel.

transcript.content: The deployment history confirms v2.3.1 is unhealthy (18% error rate) across all regions. The most recent healthy production release is **v2.3.0**. Since v2.3.0 has been healthy in production before, no change-manager approval is required. Rolling back now:
transcript.reasoning_content: Latest healthy in production: v2.3.0 (v2.2.9 also healthy but v2.3.0 is more recent). Rollback to v2.3.0, which was healthy in production, so no approval needed.

transcript.content: v2.3.0 is quarantined due to CVE-2026-4417, so I can't roll back to it. The next most recent healthy production release is v2.2.9. Rolling back to that instead:
transcript.reasoning_content: v2.3.0 is quarantined due to CVE-2026-4417. Need another path. Options: next previous healthy release is v2.2.9 (healthy). Try rolling back to v2.2.9. Check if it's quarantined too — just try.

transcript.content: Service is healthy again on v2.2.9 across all regions (error rate 0.2%). Now opening the SEV2 incident:
transcript.reasoning_content: Healthy now. Open SEV2 incident describing what was done.

4. **Opened SEV2 incident INC-0001** (on-call paged) documenting the failure, the quarantine constraint, the rollback to v2.2.9, and follow-ups: root-cause v2.3.1's failure and remediate the CVE in v2.3.0.
